['Fraport AG '].company_description: Fraport AG, commonly known as Fraport, is a German transport company which operates Frankfurt Airport in Frankfurt am Main and holds interests in the operation of several other airports around the world. The company is also involved in ground handling operations at its own operated airports and at third-party operated airports.

['Bayerngas GmbH'].company_description: Bayerngas GmbH, also known as Bayerngas, was an oil and gas company with operations in several North-European countries. The company operated upstream with licenses in Norwegian, Danish, and British sectors. Established in 2006, Bayerngas was owned by German, Austrian, and Swiss local authorities. In December 2017, Bayerngas Norge was combined with the exploration & production business of Centrica plc to create a new independent oil and gas operator, Spirit Energy.
